title: DAF XF105FTT Fups High Tensile Custom Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #2
description: DAF XF105FTT FUPS Compliant Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Custom EBS Compatible Bull Bar, features heavy duty box uprights for maximum protection. 76mm diameter high tensile aluminium tubing with pressed high tensile main channel, the two main cross tubes are one piece and pass fully through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. High tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Recessed lights in main channel and Dangerous Goods Signs on heavy duty mounting plate. Flip over Road Train signs mounted on 6mm aluminium plates with polished reverse sides. Driving light mounts to customer specification. The bullbar can be customised to suit your application.
